name: EVI Energieversorgung Hildesheim Rechenzentrum at Gefahrenabwehrzentrum Hildesheim
developer: EVI Energieversorgung Hildesheim / Stadt Hildesheim / Depenbrock Partnering
notes: New Gefahrenabwehrzentrum in Hildesheim includes an EVI-operated data center. Contract signed 2025-03-11; spatenstich/groundbreaking reported 2025-09-22; completion planned 2028. VBD cites about EUR 6 million for the data center component; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Landkreis Lüneburg Kreisverwaltung server room / Rechenzentrum
notes: DataCenter-Insider case study describes a new highly available, energy-efficient server room for the Lüneburg district administration, designed after the previous main server room reached capacity and became outdated. Small institutional facility; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: EWE Rechenzentrum OL1
notes: Colocation facility at Tirpitzstrasse 39, 26122 Oldenburg. Data Center Map lists EWE TEL as operator and notes ISO 27001 / EN 50600 services; osnatel/EWE business page states EWE operates data centers in Oldenburg and Osnabrück on 100% green electricity. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: EWE Rechenzentrum OL2
notes: Second EWE TEL Oldenburg data center listed at Cloppenburger Strasse 310, 26133 Oldenburg. Data Center Map/nearest facility listings identify OL2, and osnatel/EWE business confirms EWE data center operations in Oldenburg. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: KDO Hochleistungsrechenzentrum Oldenburg
notes: KDO official pages state that municipal applications, hosting, network services and storage are operated in its Oldenburg data center, described as an ISO-certified high-performance data center. Contact page lists Oldenburg operating locations; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: CEWE Oldenburg Rechenzentrum
notes: DataCenter-Insider reports CEWE put a new data center into operation in 2012 and received Blue Angel recognition for energy-efficient operation, replacing older server rooms and reducing CO2 emissions by about 130 tons/year. CEWE headquarters/production campus is in Oldenburg; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Ankum Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum am Lordsee / HANSALOG-HDS Rechenzentrum
developer: HANSALOG GmbH & Co. KG / HDS-Rechenzentrum GmbH
notes: B-Plan Nr. 66 and parallel FNP amendment create a special area for a data center at Am Lordsee 1 in Ankum, Landkreis Osnabrück, on the HANSALOG/HDS site. Planning documents describe a roughly 1.8 ha area and prior demolition in 2021 for planned construction; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Stadt Bramsche Neubau Rechenzentrum
notes: City of Bramsche procurement page and Vergabe Niedersachsen list 'Stadt Bramsche, Neubau Rechenzentrum' as a VOB/A awarded contract / ex post publication on 2026-06-22. Scope details and capacity are not disclosed in the public summary.

name: LückerServices Cloud-Rechenzentrum, Georgsmarienhütte
notes: Company page for the Georgsmarienhütte/Osnabrück district IT service provider advertises a CLOUD-Rechenzentrum among its core services. Treated as a small/private operating data center because public technical details, location specifics, and MW capacity are not disclosed.
